title: BackendCapabilities
description: Capability negotiation flags describing feature support by an execution backend

filesystem.description: True if isolated virtual filesystem operations are supported

networkIsolation.description: True if network policies (e.g. disabled, proxy) can be enforced

cpuLimits.description: True if CPU limits can be enforced. Currently reflects CPU time budget enforcement (cpuTimeLimit); hard core quota (cpuQuota) is experimental and reported separately.

memoryLimits.description: True if memory allocation limit caps can be enforced

streaming.description: True if real-time stdout/stderr log streaming is supported

remoteExecution.description: True if backend executes via a remote daemon or network endpoint
